description: One goal's progress day by day, newest first: the figure, the fraction of the way there and whether it was met, as the phone computed it on each sync. Use it for how a goal has gone, not only where it stands. The id is from list_goals.

client.description: For a coach: a client id from list_clients, to read that client. Omitted: your own account.

from.description: First day, inclusive. Omitted: 365 days before `to`, the most one call covers. For older rows, call again with an earlier `to`.

to.description: Last day, inclusive. Omitted: today in the account time zone.

name: goal_history
title: Goal history
